name: Chat history, delete confirmation
summary: Deleting one chat gates behind an alert. The body is explicit that memories saved from the conversation outlive it.

looseEnds.title: The dialog layer is called 'Delete memory'
looseEnds.detail: The alert on all three Chat history confirmation frames is a layer named 'Delete memory', copied from the Memory section. The copy inside is about chats.
looseEnds.ask: Rename the layer so a developer searching the file does not land in the wrong flow.

looseEnds.title: The alert carries two hidden 'Not this time' buttons
looseEnds.detail: Besides Cancel and Delete the Buttons frame holds two switched-off variants labelled 'Not this time', left over from the component's defaults.
looseEnds.ask: Strip the unused variants from the instance.
